note: Terms module-10 introduces, and the build that teaches each. Enforced by scripts/lint-glossary.mjs. Keep ASCII-only.

terms.gloss: The stream of measurements a system reports about itself, every minute. Almost all of it is fine; thresholds pick out the rest.
The value at which a measurement becomes an alert. Owned, versioned, and edited by the incidents it causes.
How bad an incident is, from impact and scope, and whether it wakes someone up. A grid, not a feeling.
Reaching a human now. A page is not handled until it is acknowledged; unacknowledged pages climb a ladder.
The numbered steps a responder follows. When a step does not match reality, that is a deviation - and the runbook's to-do list.
The write-up after an incident: timeline, impact, response, and commitments with owners. Blameless by format.
Minutes from the alert that opened an incident to the step that resolved it.
Many alerts for one problem. Deduplication attaches them to the open incident so one engineer is paged once.
